title: Nile University Library — public contact details and live catalogue limitation
text: Nile University Egypt library contact details: Library@nu.edu.eg. Telephone: (+202) 3854-1861 and (+202) 3854-1863. Published hours: Sunday–Thursday, 9 am–7 pm; weekends closed. Address: 26 July El Mehwar Road, El Sheikh Zayed. This is a dated snapshot of the official homepage, not a live catalogue or live copy-availability check.
retrieval_method: Manually reviewed public search-index copy of the official library homepage, indexed approximately two weeks before review. Direct HTTPS collection failed certificate verification; verification was not disabled.

title: American Diploma — grades 10, 11 and 12 studied at different schools
text: For an American Diploma student who spent grades 10, 11 and 12 in three different schools inside Egypt, Nile University requires a separate transcript for each grade. Each transcript must be stamped by the General Examinations Department. A certificate from only the final school is not the stated requirement.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the named section of the official page snapshot.

title: International Baccalaureate — 24 points, TOK and Extended Essay
text: For International Baccalaureate admission, the minimum accepted point total is 24. The official requirements also say students must have passed both the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge (TOK). Reaching 24 points without passing TOK is therefore not sufficient under the published requirements.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the International Baccalaureate section of the official page snapshot.

title: Nile Schools certificate — engineering L1, L2 and L3 Mathematics alternatives
text: For Engineering and Applied Sciences, Information Technology and Computer Science, and Energy and Environmental Engineering, the published Nile Schools track requires seven Level 1 subjects including English, Mathematics, Arabic, Physics and Chemistry. It then permits either two Level 2 subjects, including Mathematics plus Biology, Physics or Chemistry, or one Level 3 Mathematics subject. The Level 3 Mathematics option replaces the two Level 2 requirement; it does not replace the seven Level 1 subjects.
retrieval_method: Focused clarification checked against the Nile Schools section of the official page snapshot; punctuation on the source page is ambiguous, so the alternatives are stated without adding eligibility guarantees.

title: Canadian Diploma — Biotechnology Biology in grades 11 and 12
text: For a Canadian Diploma applicant to the Biotechnology major, the official page requires English, Mathematics and Biology. Biology is required in both grade 11 and grade 12. Biology in grade 12 alone does not meet that published subject requirement.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Canadian Diploma section of the official page snapshot.

title: Application checklist — undergraduate and master's passport photo counts
text: Nile University's undergraduate academic and non-academic application checklists require six passport-size photographs. The Master's application checklist requires four recent passport-size photographs. The two application levels therefore do not require the same number.
retrieval_method: Cross-section comparison checked against the undergraduate and Master's checklists on the official page snapshot.

title: Ph.D. MOT English requirement — TOEFL and IELTS
text: For the Ph.D. in Management of Technology, the published special English requirement is TOEFL iBT 94 or above with writing 27 or above, or IELTS 7.50 or above with writing 7.00 or above. A TOEFL iBT total of 95 with writing 26 misses the writing minimum.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Ph.D. application checklist note on the official page snapshot.

title: IGCSE completed in grade 11 — proof of pre-university education
text: For grade 11 IGCSE students, the official Nile University page asks for a private-education statement confirming completion of the pre-university education requirements (إفادة التعليم الخاص باستيفاء متطلبات التعليم ما قبل الجامعي), stamped by the General Department of Examinations (الإدارة العامة للامتحانات). This is separate from the general proof of 12 years of schooling stamped by the school and its Educational Administration.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the IGCSE grade 11 clause on the official page snapshot.

title: Admissions requirements — Oxford English B2
text: The official Admission Requirements and Documents page states an Oxford exam score of B2 or above as one English-proficiency alternative and says there are no retakes for this exam. This conflicts with the separate NU FAQ snapshot, which states B1 or above. Applicants should confirm the applicable requirement with NU admissions before booking or relying on either threshold.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Acceptance Test section of the official page snapshot.

title: NU FAQ — early admission and Oxford English B1 statement
text: The NU FAQ says students who do not yet know their grades may use early admission through the linked application system once the application opens. This does not establish that a round is open now or guarantee admission. The same FAQ says Oxford B1 or above, while the separate Admission Requirements and Documents page says Oxford B2 or above; applicants should ask NU admissions to confirm the applicable threshold before booking the test.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the official FAQ snapshot.

title: Wessal-NU charity club — contact email
text: Wessal-NU is a Nile University student charity club focused on helping families, needy children and orphans and encouraging charitable awareness. Its official club page publishes the contact email wessal_nu@nu.edu.eg.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Contact us section of the official club page snapshot.

title: Graduate Starter Pack — Simulatopedia event
text: GSP's Simulatopedia was an immersive work-life experience for undergraduate students, with career advising, market awareness, sessions, workshops and internships. It collaborated with companies including Ghabbour Auto, Brandify, NilePreneurs and The Freak to expose students to day-to-day operations. The official page says exceptional students were awarded internship opportunities; it does not promise an internship to every participant.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Simulatopedia section of the official GSP page snapshot.

title: FilmFish — collaborative short films and organizer confirmation
text: FilmFish is Nile University's film club for people who want to make short films, sketches and art-related projects through collaboration between club members. Beginners may join and learn about the film industry. The official page snapshot does not publish a weekly room or meeting time, so current meeting details must be confirmed with the club organizers.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the official FilmFish page snapshot; absence of schedule is scoped to that snapshot.

title: IECC Venture Clienting — price, timeline, pilot and PoC workflow
text: IECC Venture Clienting costs vary according to the scope of service agreed with the client; the page does not publish a fixed price. The typical 4–12 week range applies to scouting and selecting startup solutions. Execution and testing timelines depend on the specific solution and are not included in that fixed range. The service goes beyond supplying contacts: it includes pilot and demo management, proof-of-concept projects, test-case development and product-performance validation, followed by integration and scaling support when a pilot succeeds.
retrieval_method: Focused cross-section transcription checked against the How Venture Clienting Works and FAQ sections of the official service page snapshot.

title: Professional Diploma in Food Safety Management — program director
text: The official Professional Diploma in Food Safety Management program director page names Prof. Sobhy Ahmed El-Sohaimy as the program director.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the title and name on the official program director page snapshot.

title: Shrimp-shell and agricultural-waste sustainable packaging — objectives
text: The NU research project aimed to extract and optimize chitosan and other biopolymers from shrimp shells, and to reinforce the materials with chitin fibers and whiskers to enhance mechanical and barrier properties. This project-page abstract does not assign a separate quantified improvement to fibers versus whiskers or state a concentration, so those details should not be inferred from this page.
retrieval_method: Focused transcription checked against the Abstract section of the official project page snapshot.
